title: Follow-up: decide and land (or retire) the preserved `goal.binding` BLOCKED gate for plan.propose/approval.decide - bytes verbatim in task-9d2d44aa comment-eb121b7c
description:
FILED BY architect-ac8532da 2026-08-28 while planning task-9d2d44aa (goal.create offered on every read). Preservation + decision row, not a byte adoption.

WHAT IS PRESERVED. The shared worktree's apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-read.ts carried, under a skip-worktree bit, an unowned hunk that flips plan.propose and approval.decide to BLOCKED with `missing: ["goal.binding"]` whenever `planningGoalRef(ledger, projectId, DEFAULT_RUN_SUBJECT)` is null (no UNIQUE goal binds run-live-1). task-48ee1455's review (comment-6e6b1c0d) measured it as a production behaviour change with no observing arm and kept it out; task-9d2d44aa restores HEAD's 4-arg bootstrapSteps and lands only the goal.create branch. The exact hunk (signature change, gate, call site) is quoted verbatim in task-9d2d44aa comment-eb121b7c68a24cc7b6b3fb05a90af7df. Control-room consumers of the token already exist at HEAD: apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/work-labels.ts:84 ("a goal bound to this run"), live/live-dispatch.ts:141/:319 comments, v2/goals/work-board.test.tsx:155 stub.

WHY IT MUST NOT BE ADOPTED AS-IS. Once goal.create mints a fresh aggregate per read (task-9d2d44aa), goals created from the browser are `goal-<uuid>` bound to `run-<uuid>`, so NOTHING binds run-live-1 on a non-seeded project and the gate would BLOCK plan.propose forever with no browser action that can satisfy it - the same dead end task-9d2d44aa removes for goal.create. The real design question is the run subject: plan.propose/approval.decide should address the selected goal's own planningRunRef (goal-services.ts refsOfGoal) instead of the dev subject run-live-1, and the affordance surface should offer them per goal. P1.7-pre-d2 (task-e87cfddf) touches the same surface for goal.create_with_source; coordinate rather than collide.

DELIVERABLE: either (a) a per-goal run-subject design for plan.propose/approval.decide with the gate re-expressed against the goal a read addresses, landed with red-first arms; or (b) an explicit retirement of the gate with the work-labels.ts token kept or removed consistently. No mock-backed proof; no silent deletion of the preserved bytes without a recorded decision.

STEP 2 DESIGN DECISION — RETIRE `goal.binding` (measured production at HEAD 105c0c44; not inferred from a design document).

WHAT IS RETIRED. The preserved hunk in task-9d2d44aa comment-eb121b7c68a24cc7b6b3fb05a90af7df passed a singular `boundGoalRef` into `bootstrapSteps` and marked both `plan.propose` and `approval.decide` BLOCKED with `missing: ["goal.binding"]` whenever that value was null. Its singular subject was the demo seed: `DEFAULT_RUN_SUBJECT = "run-live-1"` at apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-read.ts:47 and the compatibility map still names that run at :52/:54.

WHY IT IS WRONG. Commit bb2aac06 is an ancestor of this lane. The delivered goal.create branch at affordance-read.ts:148-165 mints once, offers `goal-${commandId}`, and remains repeatable; production goal identity derives the created goal's own planning run via apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-identity.ts:35-39 (`planningRunRef: run-${subject}`). Thus a browser-created `goal-<uuid>` owns `run-<uuid>`, not `run-live-1`. On a non-seeded project, a fixed-run gate has no browser action that could bind the dev subject and would permanently block the card.

RUN-SUBJECT DECISION. Planning commands address each selected durable goal's OWN `planningRunRef`; they must not select `DEFAULT_RUN_SUBJECT`. This was the deferred design when this row was planned, but it has since landed at ec6ab47127d56b5b6267ca119dc66b9fc40c3e1b (`fix(daemon): bind planning offers per goal`, task-4451675e): apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.ts:69-76 enumerates durable goals and their `planningRunRef`; :96-101 offers `plan.propose`/`approval.decide` at that run; :108-124 resolves offers and run-to-goal bindings per goal. apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-read.ts:203-205 consumes that per-goal result; the singular seed field is compatibility only. This row adopts that landed production fact and does not duplicate it.

OWNERSHIP/SCOPE. The approved plan originally named task-e87cfddfc1a148cbbe345f26a867d787, task-0ca390d9e99d43e7bb3444d129adbf3e, and task-115fedb7622a4497958393f3597a9a5d as deferred daemon/sender rows. They remain outside this row; e87 names affordance-read.ts and task rail 1 forbids this row from editing it. The only consequence here is retiring the Control Room's phantom label/comment/test fiction.
